info.title: Listrak Email REST API
info.description:
# Introduction Welcome to the Listrak Email REST API! Our API allows developers to integrate with Listrak's application. It enables the seamless automation of a broad set of functionality, ranging from basic tasks to complex processes. We aim to provide comprehensive documentation coverage of our API's capabilities. Each resource and method is described in detail with implementation notes, descriptions of parameters, headers, return values, and code samples to aid in development. # Versioning The API version is denoted in the URI. This API's base URI is: `https://api.listrak.com/email/v1`
The API version will be incremented if breaking changes are introduced. Breaking changes may include: - Addition of required headers, parameters, or model fields to a current route - Alterations that would result in currently valid requests failing, or performing unexpectedly
Changes that are not considered breaking may include: - Addition of new model fields - Addition of new routes - Addition of new response headers - Any alteration to a route that is marked as In Development # Usage ## External Libraries The C# code examples featured on this site require the following packages: - Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client - Newtonsoft.Json The Php code examples require the following package: - Guzzle 6 # Feedback We are actively seeking feedback in the following areas: - Code samples - Response examples - Resource and field descriptions
Please provide your feedback to us at restapifeedback@listrak.com. # Integration Setup To enable API access, **you must create an _Integration_** on the _Integrations_ page. In the Listrak application left menu, go to: Integrations → Integration Management. Please specify integration type `Email` for your integration. You must also specify which areas of the API should be made accessible. Available areas include: - Contact - Event - List - Message - Reporting - Segmentation Make sure to securely store a copy of your _Client ID_ and _Client Secret_. These values will be needed to authenticate with the API. For your security, the _Client Secret_ cannot be retrieved if it is lost. # Status Codes | Status Code | Status | Description | |-|-|-| | 200 | OK | The request succeeded. | | 201 | Created | A new resource has been created. | | 400 | Bad Request | Your request is malformed or invalid. | | 401 | Unauthorized | Authentication is required. | | 404 | Not Found | The resource does not exist. | | 405 | Method Not Allowed | The route does not support the requested method. | | 415 | Unsupported Media Type | Please use a `Content-Type` of `application/json`. | | 500 | Internal Server Error | An unexpected error occurred. Our development team has been notified. | # Error Codes ## General | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_INVALID_CREDENTIALS | Invalid client credentials, inactive integration, unauthorized IP address | | ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER | Null or invalid value for a parameter, non-unique value for a parameter (if the property is required to be unique for all resources in the collection) | | ERROR_MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY | Invalid JSON body was supplied | | ERROR_RESOURCE_DEPENDENCY | Trying to delete a resource that is in use | | ERROR_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE_RESOURCE | Valid route was supplied with invalid resource IDs | | ERROR_UNAUTHORIZED | Invalid access token, inactive integration, insufficient access level, unauthorized IP address | | ERROR_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION | Unexpected error during execution of the request | | ERROR_UNKNOWN_ROUTE | Invalid route was supplied | | ERROR_UNSAFE_ROUTE | Invalid character was supplied in the route ('&' outside of query string, '<', '>', etc.) | | ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE | Invalid `Content-Type` header was supplied (must be `application/json`), missing `Content-Type` header | | ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD | Valid route supplied with an invalid HTTP method | | ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL | Request was not made over HTTPS | | ERROR_INTEGRATION_CANNOT_ACCESS_BETA_ROUTE | This route is in Beta and not yet generally available for all integrations. | ## Contact | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_BANNED_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Subscribing a contact that has been banned | | ERROR_BANNED_NEW_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Changing `emailAddress` to one that has been banned | | ERROR_CHANGE_ADDRESS_CONTACT_UNSUBSCRIBED | Changing `emailAddress` to one that has unsubscribed from the list | | ERROR_CHANGE_ADDRESS_WITH_EVENTS | Changing `emailAddress` with a list of events | | ERROR_CHANGE_ADDRESS_WITH_SEGMENTATION_DATA | Changing `emailAddress` with profile data | | ERROR_CONVERSION_ANALYTICS_NOT_ENABLED | Conversion analytics not enabled | | ERROR_NOT_SUBSCRIBED_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Unsubscribing a contact that is not a subscriber for the list | | ERROR_PENDING_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Already pending subscription through double opt-in | | ERROR_PENDING_NEW_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Changing `emailAddress` to one that is already pending subscription through double opt-in | | ERROR_SUBSCRIBED_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Subscribing a contact that has already been subscribed to the list | | ERROR_SUBSCRIBED_NEW_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Changing `emailAddress` to one that is already subscribed to the list | | ERROR_SUPPRESSED_EMAIL | Subscribing an `emailAddress` that has already been suppressed | | ERROR_SUPPRESSED_NEW_EMAIL | Changing `emailAddress` to one that has already been suppressed | | ERROR_TOO_MANY_SEGMENTATION_FIELDS | Number of requested profile fields exceeds the limit | | ERROR_UNSUBSCRIBE_WITH_EVENTS | Unsubscribing a contact with a list of events | | ERROR_UNSUBSCRIBE_WITH_SEGMENTATION_DATA | Unsubscribing a contact with profile data | | ERROR_UNSUBSCRIBED_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Unsubscribing a contact that has already been unsubscribed from the list | | ERROR_UNSUBSCRIBED_NEW_EMAIL_ADDRESS | Changing an `emailAddress` to one that has already been unsubscribed from the list | | ERROR_UPDATE_UNSUBSCRIBE_WITH_EVENTS | Updating a contact that is unsubscribed with a list of events | ## List | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_GOOGLE_TRACKING_DOMAIN_LIMIT_MET | Maximum number of Google tracking domains have already been set for the list | | ERROR_DOMAIN_ALIAS_INVALID | The provided domain alias is not a valid domain | | ERROR_DOMAIN_ALIAS_MISCONFIGURED_DNS | The DNS record for the provided domain alias does not point to the correct endpoint | | ERROR_DOMAIN_ALIAS_INVALID_HSTS | The provided domain alias has HSTS enabled for either all sub-domains, or a domain alias type we are unable to secure | | ERROR_DOMAIN_ALIAS_PROXY_CERTIFICATE_GENEREATION_FAILED | We were unable to secure the specfied domain alias | ## Message | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_REVIEW_FLAG_AND_SEND_DATE_SET | `sendReviewMessage` set to true and `sendDate` is set | | ERROR_TEST_FLAG_AND_REVIEW_FLAG_SET | `sendReviewMessage` and `sendTestMessage` set to true | | ERROR_TEST_FLAG_AND_SEND_DATE_SET | `sendTestMessage` set to true and `sendDate` is set | ## Segmentation Field Group | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_SEGMENTATION_FIELD_GROUP_LIMIT_MET | Maximum number of profile field groups have already been created for the list | ## Transactional Message | Error Code | Possible Causes | |-|-| | ERROR_SEGMENTATION_FIELD_DEFINED_TWICE | Two or more values were supplied for the same `segmentationFieldId` | | ERROR_TRANSACTIONAL_MESSAGE_EXTERNAL_CONTENT | Contains external content tags | | ERROR_TRANSACTIONAL_MESSAGE_SYSTEM_LINK | Contains system link tags | # Parameters ## Route Parameters Resource identifiers are specified in the route. For example, in the route `/Resource/{resourceId}`, `resourceId` is a route parameter. In this example, if you wish to interact with Resource #123, its route would be `/Resource/123`. ## Query Parameters Some routes support additional query parameters; for example, some resources support query parameters relating to paging. Supported query parameters are described in their respective documentation areas. ## Request Body Request bodies are required for most `POST` and `PUT` requests. Please use a `Content-Type` of `application/json` and provide a JSON object in your request body.

get.description: Returns the collection of contacts associated with the specified list.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

parameters.name: subscriptionState
parameters.description: Identifier used to specify subscription state of the contacts to retrieve. Allowed values are `Subscribed` and `Unsubscribed`. The default value is `Subscribed`.

parameters.name: externalContactId
parameters.description: External contact ID provided by the client. If provided, only returns contacts with a matching external contact ID.

parameters.name: segmentationFieldIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of profile field IDs to retrieve. Up to 30 fields may be included.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value indicating the page of data that's being retrieved. The default value is `Start`.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of data members to be displayed per page. The default value is `1000` and the maximum value is `5000`.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start date that's being used to filter the data members. This applies to subscribe date when retrieving subscribed contacts. Applies to unsubscribe date when retrieving unsubscribed contacts.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive (exclusive when `useOriginalSubscribeDate` is `false`) end date that's being used to filter the data members. This applies to subscribe date when retrieving subscribed contacts. Applies to unsubscribe date when retrieving unsubscribed contacts.

parameters.name: useOriginalSubscribeDate
parameters.description: Whether the `startDate` and `endDate` use the contact's original subscribe date or the contact's most recent subscribe date. Only applies when `subscriptionState` is `Subscribed`. The default value is `true`.

parameters.name: newEmailAddress

client.BaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.listrak.com/email/");
client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);

var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("v1/List", new
{
   ListName = null,
   FolderId = 0,
   IpPoolId = 0,
   BounceDomainAlias = null,
   BounceHandling = null,

   EnableListRemovalHeader = false,
   EnableListRemovalLink = false,
   EnableListrakAnalytics = false,

   EnableUniversalEmailKeySetting = false,

OAuth2.description:
Authentication is accomplished using OAuth 2.0. After successful authentication, your token should be included with every request using the _Bearer_ scheme; specifically, you should set your `Authorization` header value to `Bearer (Your token value)` in each request.

You may request a token by making a `POST` request to our token endpoint at `https://auth.listrak.com/OAuth2/Token`. The request should have a `Content-Type` of `x-www-form-urlencoded`, and the request body should include a `grant_type` of `client_credentials`, your `client_id`, and your `client_secret`. Here is an example of a valid request:

```
POST /OAuth2/Token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type: client_credentials
client_id: (Your client ID)
client_secret: (Your client secret)
```

For your security and convenience, you may pause and unpause your API access on our _Integration Manager_ page. All requests will be rejected while your API access is paused, including requests to issue tokens.
